{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2017-2026 Alexey Rochev <equeim@gmail.com>
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-app:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Add Kotlin problem matcher
        uses: equeim/kotlin-problem-matcher@cd8d50db272bc44d8ecfac02dcc46ec9cd489a49

      - name: Set up Java 25
        uses: actions/setup-java@03ad4de0992f5dab5e18fcb136590ce7c4a0ac95
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 25

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@0723195856401067f7a2779048b490ace7a47d7c
        with:
          cache-read-only: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
          cache-encryption-key: ${{ secrets.GRADLE_ENCRYPTION_KEY }}

      - name: Build the app
        run: |
          ./gradlew build

      - name: Archive debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: debug-apk
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/fdroid/debug/app-fdroid-debug.apk
          retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 3 || github.retention_days }}

      - name: Archive unsigned release APKs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: unsigned-release-apks
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/*/release/*.apk
          retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 3 || github.retention_days }}

      - name: Archive test and lint reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: reports
          path: |
            app/build/reports/*
            billing/build/reports/*
            common/build/reports/*
            rpc/build/reports/*
            torrentfile/build/reports/*
          retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 3 || github.retention_days }}

  reuse-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Check REUSE compliance
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get --no-install-recommends --assume-yes install pipx
          pipx run reuse lint
",
  "rationale": "The workflow has no job-level timeouts. Evidence pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) reports reduced runaway consumption, and the experiment example shows a measured 26.8% elapsed reduction when a timeout was added. The repository CI history shows five successful schedule runs with durations between roughly 1 and 10 minutes, satisfying the precondition that representative successful-duration history exists. Adding timeout-minutes of 30 to build-app and 10 to reuse-lint provides operational headroom over observed durations while bounding runaway jobs. No permissions are weakened, no new secrets or network access are added, and build/test coverage is preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
